lattice_stdout.recover-under-a: the retained execution observation of launch B (result.disposition failed), not a closure

pregate-rejected.observed: Under profile A (output A, root A) without a fresh owner observation, Kiln prepared output A and root A and the owner-grant gate refused (admission: missing fresh provider offer); nothing was recorded. Under profile B (output B, root B) with the observation, Kiln recorded launch B with the transport intent and Lattice ran in B. The retry under profile A recovered with B's recorded launch, reconciled B's execution without a second endpoint request, and root A stayed empty.

lattice_stdout.recover-moved: the retained execution observation (result.disposition failed), not a closure

moved-root.observed: Kiln's acknowledgement was lost while Lattice ran the first launch under root A (SIGKILL of kiln-lattice-dispatch after the worker reached the endpoint). The profile then named root B. Kiln recovered with the launch recorded in the transport intent (root A), reconciled the retained execution with no second endpoint request, and never created root B; the replay reconciled the same execution.

lost-before-start.begin_transport: previously_started false; launch_recorded names the Lattice pin and the scenario's state root
lost-before-start.observed: The transport intent recorded the launch; recovery ran in the recorded root, and its exact closure record was settled as no execution; the replay is refused before transport.

lost-during-run.observed: SIGKILL of the controller; recovery with the recorded launch reconciles the retained result without re-execution.

lattice_stdout.stale-fence-replay: status not_started_closed_by_recovery from recover in the recorded root

refusals.observed: stale_fence is not settled; the dispatch keeps the attempt with its transport intent. The replay recovers with the recorded launch; Lattice finds no intent there and exclusively closes the attempt, and Kiln records that closure as no execution. kiln-crossed-fence is refused at claim authorization and kiln-unplanned before plan reservation, both before any durable step.

crossed.observed: A run refusal of a reason the reviewer verified settles, clearing the intent and its launch; the replay is refused by Kiln before transport.

changed: refusals: stale_fence stays retained on dispatch; recovery with the recorded launch then closes the attempt and Kiln settles it as no execution (before: retained with an unreconciled intent)
lost-before-start: the recovered closure is no execution (before: reconciled as an execution); the replay is refused
worker requests carry dispatch_plan; observations echo it
comparison_with_lattice_evidence.unchanged: lost-during-run exits and endpoint request count

non_claims: No model was called; every worker reached only the local HTTP 400 endpoint, so no candidate was produced
The credential pass-through was exercised by unit tests and a real child process, not by this composed run; every broker here declares credential:null
The recorded state root is assumed durable; losing or replacing it in place voids the no-start evidence of a closure recovered from it
The two-process gate race is covered by worker::preparation_tests::the_gate_loser_of_two_processes_leaves_no_launch, not by this composed run
A crash between the owner-grant gate and the transport intent (a window that predates this change) is not exercised and remains open
The Lattice binary is a local release build of the published commit added to the Nix store, not a Nix-built package
The live scenario, Kiln #49 deployment and Kiln #46 independent acceptance remain separate
